scope: Real anonymous Shopify Ajax carts to GoDaddy checkout quote, before payment

evidence.source: Vercel Preview build logs retrieved through connected Vercel tool

method.storefrontCart: Real localized Shopify Ajax cart/add.js and cart.js, isolated anonymous cookie jars
method.serverValidation: Independent Shopify cart recalculation and actual Admin API product lookups
method.providerAccess: Actual GoDaddy authentication and read-only store verification
method.handlerInvocation: Actual API handlers invoked inside the Vercel Preview process, not through the public HTTP endpoint
